export.step5Zip: Every combination is composited at full size and packed into one ZIP.
export.step5Folder: Every combination is composited at full size and written to the folder you pick.
export.jpeg: JPEG (lossy, small, transparent areas become white)
export.lossyHint: JPEG / WebP are lossy, so pixels will not match the PSD exactly. Use PNG for exact output.
export.tokens: Tokens: {psd} file name, {combo} every option name, {primary} first group option, {index} 001 counter, {n} 1 counter. Duplicates get (2), (3).
export.threads: Worker threads composite layers while an encoder compresses the previous image; unchanged tiles are reused.
export.hintAndroid: After tapping export, pick where the ZIP goes (e.g. Downloads) in the system dialog.
export.hintDesktop: After picking where the ZIP goes, the folder opens automatically when it finishes.
export.hintWeb: The browser downloads the ZIP when it finishes.
export.tickHint: Tick images on the Combos page, or press "all" to export everything again.
export.violationNote: {n} of them break an exclusion rule and are exported too.
export.configHint: Save the groups, rules, export settings, visibility changes, part groups and ticks as a .json. Workflow: import a new PSD → import the config → export. Layers are matched by group/name and renamed ones are reported.
export.resetAll: Clear every setting for this file and go back to a fresh import
export.autoRestore: Restore settings automatically when the same file is opened again
export.confirmBig: Export {n} full-size images? This can take a while.
export.byPrimaryFolder: Split into folders by the first group: {name}
export.scopeTickedHint: Unticked images on the Combos page are skipped.
export.scopeValidHint: Ignore the Combos page selection and export every combination that follows the rules.
export.scopeAllHint: Ignore exclusions too and export every combination the groups can make.
export.folderAndroid: After tapping Export, choose a folder; images are written there one by one.
export.folderDesktop: After choosing a folder, it opens automatically when export finishes.
export.folderWeb: Choose a folder after export; your browser must support the File System Access API.
export.zipAndroid: A system Save to dialog opens after export. Choose where to save the ZIP (such as Downloads).
